title: What Hibernate ORM Is All About
description: Java's ORM standard: JPA implementation, session cache, and HQL.. This database covers Hibernate ORM with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. ORMs map objects to tables; the impedance mismatch is real.
definition: Hibernate ORM — Java's ORM standard: JPA implementation, session cache, and HQL.
key_points: ORMs map objects to tables; the impedance mismatch is real.
N+1 queries are the classic ORM disease; eager load or batch.
Lazy loading hides queries; profile to see them.
The unit of work batches changes; understand its flush.

Profile for N+1; add eager loading where needed.
Add database constraints; don't rely on validations.
Write migrations; review the SQL they emit.
